_doc: Slug -> NOAA Fisheries commercial-landings species. The domestic (US wild-caught) pair for the seafood IMPORT streams already in the corpus, so a seafood ingredient can carry an import-vs-domestic-landings read the way crops carry import-vs-NASS-production reliance. Landings are US commercial catch VALUE + pounds (public domain, NOAA FOSS). This is a WILD-CATCH domestic figure paired against a largely-AQUACULTURE import stream — a chain seam the surface must name, never a clean supply share.
_source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS (Fisheries One Stop Shop) commercial landings. Public domain (US Government work). Fetch runs on the operator's Mac.
_fields: codes[slug] = { species: NOAA AFS common-name query (a name or prefix; several NOAA species may roll up to one culinary category), note? }.
_status: BUILT AHEAD, NEEDS FIRST-PULL VERIFICATION. Species names are candidate AFS common names from culinary knowledge; the exact NOAA strings + whether a prefix or an explicit species set is needed must be confirmed against the first FOSS probe (the same build-ahead-then-verify pattern that just caught the NASS class bug). No builder consumes this yet.

shrimp.note: US wild penaeid (Gulf/South Atlantic) + pandalid (cold-water); imports are mostly farmed — name the wild-vs-farmed seam.

shrimp-pd.note: peeled/deveined is a cut of the same wild landing

shrimp-head-on.note: head-on is a form of the same wild landing

salmon-fillet.note: US wild = Pacific/Alaska (chinook, coho, sockeye, pink, chum); Atlantic salmon is farmed

dover-sole.note: US 'dover sole' = Pacific dover sole (a flatfish), distinct from European Dover sole

whole-crab.note: blue, dungeness, king, snow/tanner roll up

mahi-mahi.note: mahi-mahi's AFS common name is dolphinfish — verify the exact NOAA string

tuna-loin.note: yellowfin/bigeye/albacore/bluefin/skipjack roll up; a loin is a cut

whole-trout.note: US wild trout landings are small — most trout is farmed (NASS aquaculture); may degrade by absence

_deliberately_absent.tilapia: farmed + imported; negligible US wild landing (a domestic pair would come from NASS aquaculture, not NOAA)
_deliberately_absent.branzino: European sea bass; no US wild fishery
_deliberately_absent.catfish: US catfish is farmed (NASS Catfish survey), not a NOAA wild landing
_deliberately_absent.canned-tuna: a processed product, not a landing — the wild tuna catch is carried by tuna-loin / ahi-tuna
